recentItems.title: Kyiv under CONTINUOUS ATTACK by Russia, and a HALF-TON BOMB dropped on Sloviansk!
recentItems.description:
Russia is escalating strikes on Ukrainian cities and civilian infrastructure. Kyiv and the surrounding region have been under attack for several consecutive days, leaving people injured and causing widespread destruction. In Sloviansk, an airstrike damaged dozens of homes, while the frontline town of Druzhkivka suffers daily from guided aerial bombs and FPV drones. Gas stations, transport, and logistics have become specific targets for the Russian military. In response, Ukraine is deploying concrete shelters, gabions, anti-drone netting, and establishing protected transit routes. Despite hundreds of damaged gas stations, there is no fuel shortage. Also in this episode — the resistance movement inside Russia and Polish special forces training based on the combat experience of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.

recentItems.title: CIA CHIEF IN MOSCOW: WHAT IS REALLY GOING ON BEHIND CLOSED DOORS?
recentItems.description:
The CIA chief went to Moscow. Behind closed doors, John Ratcliffe met Russia’s top intelligence officials in the most significant US–Russia intelligence contact in years. What was discussed remains largely unknown — but the timing is raising questions about the future of the war in Ukraine.

Also this week:

· CIA Director John Ratcliffe holds talks with Russia’s foreign intelligence chief Sergei Naryshkin in Moscow

· Russia’s stock market comes under pressure after reports of attacks on major industrial facilities

· A leaked Sberbank memo reportedly estimates Russia’s chances of victory at just 7%

· Britain moves toward enabling Storm Shadow component production in Ukraine

· The UK seeks access to Ukraine’s battlefield data for AI development

· The EU approves €6.1 billion in defence funding for Ukraine

· France and Italy move to expand Aster 30 air-defence production

· Reports emerge of explosions more than 6,000 kilometres from Ukraine — with no confirmed attribution

· Ukraine demands the return of a pensioner from Tokmak sentenced to 15 years in Russia

The war continues on the battlefield. But behind the scenes, intelligence channels between Washington and Moscow are active again.

recentItems.title: HELLISH STRIKE 820 KM AWAY! Ukraine wipes out UAV bases in Millerovo, and shoots down 125 targets!
recentItems.description:
A night of large-scale air confrontation: Russian occupation forces launched a combined strike on Ukrainian territory, firing two Iskander ballistic missiles and 130 attack drones. Air defense units demonstrated extremely high effectiveness, destroying 125 enemy drones. At the same time, infrastructure damage was recorded in Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia and Mykolaiv regions, while in Odesa, the occupiers cynically struck historic sites protected by UNESCO.

The response from Ukraine’s Defense Forces was devastating and set a new range record: Ukrainian long-range drones flew more than 820 kilometers from the border, attacking critical military and energy facilities deep inside Russia!

recentItems.title: THIS FALL! 300,000-600,000 Russians deployed to front. Intelligence warns of new mobilization
recentItems.description:
The Kremlin is preparing an unprecedented new wave of forced mobilization in scale, which, according to Ukraine’s Defense Intelligence (GUR), could affect between 300,000 and 600,000 people. Federal authorities have already rolled out total digital control, introducing electronic conscription notices and expanding police infrastructure for mass call-ups.

In this “Special Report,” we will show shocking footage of men in Russia being detained right on the streets, in the metro, and at their workplaces. You will see and hear testimonies about brutal torture and extrajudicial punishments for those who refuse to take part in senseless “meat grinder” assaults. The flow of volunteers has practically dried up, while the Russian army’s colossal losses continue to outpace the rate of replenishment with fresh manpower.

Leading military and political experts on our show explain why the new mobilization will not change the strategic situation at the front, but will only lead to new massive casualties among the mobilized and to heightened social tension inside Russia. Watch this episode to see what awaits Russians in the coming months!
